title: Lost in Familiar Place
situation: I got a call from the grocery store manager. Mom went shopping with her aide but somehow got separated. They found her in the parking lot crying, saying she doesn't know where she is. I'm 20 minutes away. The aide is with her now but Mom doesn't seem to recognize her.

patient_profile.name: Dorothy
behavioral_patterns: has shopped at this store for 30 years
calming_strategies: holding her purse gives her a sense of control
safety_concerns: has tried to leave with strangers who 'seem familiar'

notes: Should give phone-based guidance the caregiver can relay to the aide. Should NOT suggest quizzing Dorothy about where she is. Should explain that spatial navigation breaks down in middle-stage dementia even in once-familiar places. Recommend having the aide give Dorothy her purse and hum the familiar song while waiting. Discuss prevention strategies for future outings.
